segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for jumping on, Dana. I wanted to tighten up the launch plan for the 84 seats and the July 1 go-live. We have the order form at $42,300 for the first year, net 45, and legal is fine with the renewal cap language you sent.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The commercial pieces look fine. My main concern is the admin training and the data load. Our ops lead is planning around seeing real ticket history before the June 18 training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, and I need to own something there. On the May 22 call we agreed we would load 18 months of ticket history into the sandbox by June 10. That never made it into the onboarding team's kickoff notes. They came in this morning scoped for the standard 90-day sample load, so they were surprised, and that's on me. I apologized to Priya already; the data team can still do the 18 months, but the sandbox date moves from June 10 to June 12.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's not ideal. We told our regional managers they'd be reviewing actual closed tickets on the 11th. If it's the 12th, I need a clean answer today so I'm not moving people twice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Clean answer is June 12 by noon Central for the 18-month sandbox, and I'll put that in the project tracker while we're on the phone. The June 18 admin training stays as-is, 10 to noon Central, recorded, with the 12 admins you listed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. And the invoice? Our finance team asked for the platform fee split between cost centers 410 and 422, 60/40. I saw a single invoice in the portal this morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, second miss from our side. We agreed in writing last Friday to split the annual invoice 60/40 across those two cost centers, and that instruction did not get to the billing team before they ran invoices. They issued one invoice for the full $42,300 at 8:14 this morning. I'm sorry, that's awkward and avoidable. Billing is voiding it and reissuing two invoices today: $25,380 to cost center 410 and $16,920 to 422, both net 45.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please make sure the old invoice is actually voided. Our AP team will reject duplicates, but it creates noise.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. I'll send you the void confirmation and the two new invoice numbers by 3 pm Eastern. No change to contract dates, and the purchase order number 78126 will be on both invoices.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. If I have the data-load confirmation and corrected invoices today, we're good to keep July 1. Send the notes after this call.
